_note: Labelled headlines for the story matcher. 'real-' items are headlines collected by this site in October 2026, grouped by the matcher and then reviewed by hand (the YouGov tourist-tax poll pair is a known miss). 'syn-' items are hand-written edge cases: one-word advisory headlines told apart by their teasers, same company different news, same city different news, opposite actions. Evergreen listicles and multi-story roundups are left out: they report no single event.
